signature_moves.description: Rhythmic stomping while moving in a circle.
signature_moves.name: Circle Stomp

music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by communal, unison vocalization of rhyming poetry and the percussive beat of shoulder-slung Babadok hand drums.
music_profile.vocal_style: unison singing of poems and rhymes

basic_steps: Hold hands with neighbors to form a circle.
Stomp feet in rhythm with the song.
Execute simultaneous left and right movements.
teaching.rhythm: rhythmic stomping according to the song
